Check the release page for current Frostpass support and downloads.

title: Avalanca: Downhill Riot
description: Explore Avalanca: Downhill Riot, a cel-shaded downhill arcade game with drifting, tricks, multiple rides, and a browser edition.
label: Game
terms: Explore Avalanca: Downhill Riot, a cel-shaded downhill arcade game with drifting, tricks, multiple rides, and a browser edition. Lite includes solo Tundra Race, Time Attack, and Free Ride with Snowboard and Custom Rider/Odonis. Full includes its existing content and local multiplayer offline. Available builds and Frostpass access are described on the official release page.

title: A Rocket’s Intensity
description: Play A Rocket’s Intensity in your browser: arcade flight, varied missions, original art styles, and a direct-connect web arena from Drunk Yeti.
label: Game
terms: Play A Rocket’s Intensity in your browser: arcade flight, varied missions, original art styles, and a direct-connect web arena from Drunk Yeti. The hosted game identifies itself as a release candidate. The browser experience includes an arcade-flight hangar and a direct-connect web arena. Steam multiplayer is a separate path; a browser link does not establish Steam connectivity or feature parity with a desktop build.

title: Snowlight
description: Meet Snowlight, Drunk Yeti’s arcade snowboarding game with original riders, tricks, and two-player local split-screen racing.
label: Game
terms: Meet Snowlight, Drunk Yeti’s arcade snowboarding game with original riders, tricks, and two-player local split-screen racing. The Lite demo includes the Neon course and two starting riders, Odonis and Schmuck. Full is the standalone offline edition. Optional sign-in supports account features; read the release page for current Frostpass integration and available platform downloads.

title: Hexfold
description: Discover Hexfold, a six-suit 3D card game from Drunk Yeti with a 78-card deck, AI opponents, and themed lounges.
label: Game
terms: Discover Hexfold, a six-suit 3D card game from Drunk Yeti with a 78-card deck, AI opponents, and themed lounges. The official release page lists the current preview, Lite demo, Full downloads, and account integrations. This is a practice-points game: there is no real-money wagering, and practice points have no monetary value.

title: Yeti Forge
description: Prepare sprites, animation, images, and audio with Yeti Forge, Drunk Yeti’s free local asset workbench for game creators.
label: Tool
terms: Prepare sprites, animation, images, and audio with Yeti Forge, Drunk Yeti’s free local asset workbench for game creators. All creation tools and exports are free; no login or subscription is required. Optional account themes are cosmetic. The current release page distinguishes the packaged Linux build from Windows/macOS source launchers and explains system requirements.

title: YHETI Studio
description: Explore YHETI Studio, a music creation release candidate with editable MIDI parts, a synth, drum kits, audio clips, and export tools.
label: Tool
terms: Explore YHETI Studio, a music creation release candidate with editable MIDI parts, a synth, drum kits, audio clips, and export tools. YHETI Studio RC3 is a release candidate with defined limits, including four MIDI tracks, two audio lanes, 64 bars, and a 180-second import window per source. Optional plugin hosting has platform-specific requirements. Read the current release notes before choosing it for a production workflow.
